description: This file contains portable C++ templates and classes for safe integer arithmetic operations, including checked addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other numeric utilities, used internally within the angle namespace.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState
classes.description: Template class managing the state and validity of numeric values, specialized for integer and floating point types.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState<T, NUMERIC_INTEGER>
classes.description: Manages state for integer types, including validity and value.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState<T, NUMERIC_FLOATING>
classes.description: Manages state for floating point types, including validity and value.

methods.name: CheckedAdd
methods.description: Performs checked addition of two integers, setting validity status.

methods.name: CheckedSub
methods.description: Performs checked subtraction of two integers, setting validity status.

methods.name: CheckedMul
methods.description: Performs checked multiplication of two integers, with different implementations based on size.

methods.name: CheckedDiv
methods.description: Performs checked division, handling overflow for signed min/-1 case.

methods.name: CheckedNeg
methods.description: Checks and performs negation, handling overflow for signed min.

methods.name: CheckedAbs
methods.description: Checks and performs absolute value, handling overflow for signed min.

methods.name: CheckedUnsignedAbs
methods.description: Returns unsigned absolute value, special handling for signed min.
